snippet.title: Case of 1980™ - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Case of 1980™
Wishlist Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4914110/Case_of_1980/

A sudden call from your grandfather pulls you back to the family farm. As Nathan, you arrive expecting a routine visit, only to stumble upon a horrifying reality tied to a 1980 crime. Trapped and isolated, you must face the entities lurking in the shadows and survive the night.

@DesertBoyGames
